extensionDescription.message: A compatible, cross-browser proxy profile manager.

browserAction_attachedPrefix.description: A prefix prepended to the matching details if an attached profile has matched the request.

browserAction_defaultRuleDetails.description: Matching details if the default condition is used.

browserAction_directResult.description: Matching details if no proxy is used for the request.

browserAction_tempRulePrefix.description: A prefix prepended to the matching details if a temporary rule has matched the request.

browserAction_titleExternalProxy.description: The last line of the title of the toolbar icon when the proxy is set by other extensions, policies, command line options, etc.

browserAction_titleInspect.description: The last line of the title of the toolbar icon while inspecting proxy used for requests on the current tab.

browserAction_titleWithResult.description: Title of the toolbar icon, indicating that the last request on the current tab is routed under profile $1, with matching details $3.

manifest_icon_default_title.description: Default title for the toolbar icon shown while loading.
